issues.title: Research user receives no supported answer despite relevant scholarly candidates; validate end-to-end research and Arc payment evidence

Stage immutable releases before draining production writers to shorten maintenance
Ordinary browser research aborts at planning for systemd and SQLite comparisons
Ordinary browser SQLite backup research aborts during decide with invalid target links
Decision brief ends with an empty answer on real multi-page reads (deepseek-v4-flash)
Live persona acceptance needs a fresh bounded model/search allowance
Quick teacher lesson returns missing-evidence placeholders for requested facts and proposed activities
Two-original Quick SQLite synthesis hits its 2560-token ceiling and drops to fallback
Paid newest-release research selects an older article and returns no supported answer
HTML preformatted RFC evidence loses wrapped rule continuations and omits CSV quoting answers
Spanish exact NASA query retains Orbit and Rotation headings but drops the substantive section

Public usage figures mix outside users, team activity and scripted tests
Paid deliverables have no accept, revise or reject step

Anonymous runs cannot be claimed: return a single-use claim link with every unowned run
Telegram, Discord and Slack users cannot link their chat account to a Keryx account
No public page for a person who asks: add an opt-in profile at /u/<handle>
Profile links are unverified: add ORCID and GitHub verification
Every question is public: add per-run visibility, export and deletion for the owner
An account is one wallet: allow one profile with several wallets and wallet-free sign-in
Personal history covers web sessions only: show a user every run they own across surfaces
No audited way to assign known past runs to a consenting user
Tracking: user profiles, run ownership and public researcher pages
Web app is English only: add locale negotiation, typed message catalogues and a language switcher
User-facing text is hard-coded in components: move it into the English catalogue by area
Payment and trust terms need a fixed glossary and human review in every language
Dates, numbers and USDC amounts are formatted for English only
Ship interface languages in waves: Vietnamese and Simplified Chinese first
Chat bots, emails and report scaffolding reply in English regardless of the question language
Public pages declare English metadata for every language: add language tags, alternates and localized previews
Tracking: multilingual interface and localized output on every surface
Research groups cannot share a budget: add a workspace with member limits and approvals
Researchers cannot claim their own papers and earn citation rewards
Planned maintenance returns a bare 502 on the site, health and API
No way to check an existing draft: verify each claim against the sources it cites
Literature workspace stops before the deliverable: build a related-work draft from a saved review
Users have no reason to return: add topic watches with a spending limit
References must be imported by hand: connect Zotero, a synced .bib and CSL-JSON
Operator finances are spread across pages: add one public ledger with per-job margin

Run paid mainnet pilots with three research groups and record accepted results

Settlement is learned by polling: use nanopayment settlement hooks, Gateway webhooks and reconciliation

Purchase decisions are never scored against outcomes: add hit rate, regret and calibration

Decisions cannot be re-run by a reader: add canonical records and deterministic replay
The value of paying for sources is unmeasured: run and publish a controlled study
Unmet source needs go nowhere: let the agent post funded bounties for missing sources
No single record of Circle and Arc usage with proof: add an integration ledger and gasless user actions
No guided path that shows the whole loop working: add a self-running walkthrough with verification
Operator acts only when prompted: add a bounded unattended operating cycle
Tracking: agent quality, platform use and novelty for the event
Shared root causes behind the open answer-quality issues
Spanish question receives Portuguese section labels and an English confidence banner
